research_contract.target: Determine which pinned authoritative public benchmarks can add repository-local, time-ordered rolling-Origin supply and reusable public Agent outcomes without paid calls.
required_evidence: exact upstream repository revision and data-file identity
actual Task and repository counts from projected source rows
repository-local non-overlapping Origin capacity under frozen protocols
timestamp, schema, license, verifier, lineage, overlap, and public-result coverage limits
a source-by-source adopt, defer, confirmation-only, or reject decision
non_solutions: ranking a source by headline Task count
combining repositories into one runtime Task Pool
counting repository names as independent evidence without a lineage audit
treating source capacity as certification or Agent-outcome evidence
treating sparse leaderboard scores as a complete Agent-by-Task matrix
developing a Generator or making a paid Agent call

descriptor_only_sources.reason: The official revision is split across repository-specific JSONL files, some hundreds of megabytes each, and has no successful compact datasets-server projection. Audit official manifests, results, and per-repository counts without pretending headline totals are executable Origin evidence.
Use the official per-repository table as a sparse cross-language confirmation source; do not treat it as training supply under the frozen minimum history.
Use the official release manifests as a freshness confirmation source; audit accumulated repository depth before any future training use.

source_policy.authoritative_sources: Official benchmark repositories, datasets, papers, and experiment repositories only.
source_policy.raw_artifacts: External datasets and repositories remain under ignored outputs. Commit only the frozen plan, code, sanitized aggregate results, source identities, and report.
source_policy.timestamp_semantics: Task created_at is used only for source-time-cutoff-safe counterfactual capacity. It is not evidence that Agent Results existed at the historical cutoff.
source_policy.runtime_invariant: Every Task Pool, Origin, and Selection remains repository-local. Cross-repository aggregation is offline research only.

authority.network_reads: Allowed for pinned public source and result metadata.
